mapper.select: SELECT o.*, sb.name as bookName, sb.author, sb.image, oi.price as totalPrice, oi.quantity FROM `orders` o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN second_book sb ON (o.book_id IS NOT NULL AND o.book_id = sb.id) OR (oi.book_id IS NOT NULL AND oi.book_id = sb.id) WHERE o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.*, sb.name as bookName, sb.author, sb.image, oi.price as totalPrice, oi.quantity FROM `orders` o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN second_book sb ON (o.book_id IS NOT NULL AND o.book_id = sb.id) OR (oi.book_id IS NOT NULL AND oi.book_id = sb.id) WHERE o.seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.*, sb.name as bookName, sb.author, sb.image, oi.price as totalPrice, oi.quantity FROM `orders` o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN second_book sb ON (o.book_id IS NOT NULL AND o.book_id = sb.id) OR (oi.book_id IS NOT NULL AND oi.book_id = sb.id) WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.*, sb.name as bookName, sb.author, sb.image, oi.price as totalPrice, oi.quantity FROM `orders` o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN second_book sb ON (o.book_id IS NOT NULL AND o.book_id = sb.id) OR (oi.book_id IS NOT NULL AND oi.book_id = sb.id) ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
SELECT o.*, oi.price as totalPrice FROM `orders` o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.book_id = #{bookId} OR oi.book_id = #{bookId}

SELECT o.*, sb.name as bookName, sb.author, sb.image, oi.price as totalPrice, oi.quantity FROM `orders` o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN second_book sb ON o.book_id = sb.id WHERE o.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND o.urged = 1 AND o.status IN ('pending', 'paid') ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.*, sb.name as bookName, sb.author, sb.image, oi.price as totalPrice, oi.quantity FROM `orders` o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN second_book sb ON o.book_id = sb.id WHERE o.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND o.buyer_confirmed = 1 AND o.status = 'shipped' ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
